Thanks Camila — quick checklist from procurement side (short):

1) W-8BEN-E received and appears complete — confirm the FATCA classification on Part I, line 5 (they should be a corporation or other entity type, not an individual).
2) Irish TIN provided — good, but we need a copy of the government-issued document showing that TIN (screenshot of the revenue portal or tax authority letter) OR a stamped tax residency certificate for treaty benefits.
3) For PO issuance: procurement can create a PO conditional on receiving a standard invoice and proof of bank details (cancelled check equivalent or bank letter).
4) Finance (Vivek) to confirm whether Redwood needs withholding relief documentation for EU suppliers — typically not for goods/services, but depends on jurisdiction and our ERP tax rules.

Actionables:
- Camila: ask Aurora for a certificate of tax residency OR a screenshot of their Irish revenue registration showing IE3456789. If they can sign via DocuSign, that helps the audit trail.
- Vivek: confirm whether Redwood Finance will require additional IRS-style forms or a local certificate for our vendor master.

I'll hold PO creation until receipt of the residency doc and bank evidence. We can mark the PO as "Pending tax evidence" in the system to avoid accidental approval.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.ai

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>

Date: 2028-11-02T15:30:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Initial tax paperwork for Redwood PO setup

Priyom — agree with the checklist. A couple of legal notes:

- W-8BEN-E is acceptable proof of foreign status for US withholding purposes; because Aurora is an Irish entity, they should provide either a certificate of residence (tax residency certificate) or a copy of a government-issued document that ties the IE TIN to the entity. We prefer the residency certificate when reduced withholding rates or treaty claims might be asserted.
- If Aurora cannot produce a certificate within 5–7 business days, we can accept a clear screenshot from the Irish Revenue online portal showing the company name + IE3456789, provided the screenshot includes a timestamp and is accompanied by the signed W-8BEN-E.
- DocuSign is fine for signature capture; please ensure the envelope includes a completed W-8BEN-E PDF and a field for the signer's capacity (e.g., Director / CFO).

Suggested reply to Aurora (Camila): ask for either: (A) stamped/issued tax residency certificate, or (B) Ireland Revenue portal screenshot showing IE3456789 + confirmation via DocuSign that Liam is signing as an authorized officer. Also request bank letter for payment routing.

I attached a short vendor tax checklist for internal use. Once we have the residency proof, procurement can create a PO with the status note and finance can complete vendor master entry.

Mina Haddad
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai
